subject: Procurement readiness & commercial path — next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@acmecloud.com>, Priya Desai <priya@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-22T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up: procurement readiness & next steps (post demo)

Hi Jordan / Priya —

Thanks again for taking the demo this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

- Goal: Get procurement clarity (PO vs corporate card) and an internal timeline so we can reserve Dedicated capacity and schedule onboarding.
- Items AcmeCloud needs from Redwood: SOC2 report, contract SOW + MSA redline, pricing sheet, and a mutual action plan (MAM) with milestone dates.
- Proposed owner: Jordan to confirm procurement path; Marissa to provide docs and MAM template; Marcus to support legal/security questions; Laura to route pricing/finance answers.

Ask: Can you confirm whether procurement prefers a PO or do you have an AWS Marketplace procurement path you want to pursue? If PO, what is the target issuance date?

I attached a first-draft MAM and the pricing spreadsheet for initial review (stubs below). If helpful, we can set a short MAM alignment call later this week.

Thanks —
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
redwood.com

Attachments: redwood-mam-acmecloud-v1.pdf (MAM stub), redwood-pricing-acmecloud-20260324.xlsx (pricing stub)

From: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@acmecloud.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya@acmecloud.com>, Finance Ops <procurement@acmecloud.com>
Date: 2026-03-23T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: procurement readiness & next steps (post demo)

Thanks Marissa — great demo. Quick answers from procurement: 

- We prefer to pay via PO for any reserved capacity or contractual commitments. For initial POC / eval we can use corporate card, but Production/Reserved capacity will need a PO.
- AWS Marketplace is an option but requires additional approvals (we'd prefer Marketplace if pricing parity and invoicing work).
- High-level timeline: legal review -> security questionnaire -> finance approval -> PO issuance. Legal and security have separate queues; target start for legal is next week (Mar 30).

Can you confirm: 
1) Do you have an MSA + SOW template we can push to legal?
2) Who on your side owns the SOC2 / security artifacts delivery?
3) Do you support DocuSign for contract signature?

Jordan
Director, Procurement — AcmeCloud

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@acmecloud.com>, Priya Desai <priya@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-24T08:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: procurement readiness & next steps (post demo)

Jordan — thanks, clear notes. Answers below and attached artifacts.

1) MSA + SOW: attached MAM includes the proposed milestones and SOW checklist. We also attached our standard MSA (redwood-msav1 link included in Drive).
2) SOC2 / security artifacts: Marcus will own delivery of the SOC2 report and our security questionnaire responses. I attached the SOC2 2025 report stub for now.
3) DocuSign: yes — we execute via DocuSign. We can also process via AWS Marketplace if you decide that route; Marketplace invoicing typically takes an additional ~2 weeks.

Proposed mutual action plan (high level):
- Mar 24: Redwood sends MAM + pricing + SOC2 (DONE — attached)
- Mar 30: AcmeCloud legal kickoff (you)
- Apr 6: Security questionnaire and follow-ups (Redwood will respond within 3 business days of receipt)
- Apr 13: Finance review and PO approval
- Apr 15: Target PO issuance / contract signature

Notes on commercial path:
- If you go Marketplace: invoice handled by AWS, PO route is different and signature cadence may shift; expected PO date then would be ~Apr 29.
- If direct PO: we can execute the MSA + SOW via DocuSign and issue Redwood invoice on receipt of PO.

Next steps:
- Jordan: confirm whether to pursue Marketplace or direct PO by Mar 27.
- Marissa: schedule 30m MAM alignment call for Mar 25 if helpful.

Thanks,
Marissa

Attachments referenced: redwood-mam-acmecloud-v1.pdf, redwood-pricing-acmecloud-20260324.xlsx, soc2-report-2025.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-25T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: AcmeCloud procurement — legal/security/finance heads-up

Folks — looping you in on AcmeCloud (DEAL-ACME-1345). Summary:
- They prefer PO for reserved capacity; possible AWS Marketplace alternative.
- Proposed dates: legal kickoff 2026-03-30, security questionnaire Apr 6, finance review Apr 13, PO issuance target Apr 15.
- Requested artifacts: SOC2 report, MSA + SOW template, pricing spreadsheet.

Marcus: can you confirm we can turn around the security questionnaire responses within 3 business days once they send? Also please attach the SOC2 report and any runbooks or TLS cert statements we should include.
Laura: finance may need to confirm invoicing terms for PO vs Marketplace. If Marketplace, invoicing/collection timeline will be different; please advise any red flags.

If we want to accelerate legal, I can offer a limited-scope SOW to shorten the redline cycle. Let me know availability for a brief pre-kickoff call with Acme legal on Mar 30.

Thanks —
Marissa

From: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@acmecloud.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priya Desai <priya@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Finance Ops <procurement@acmecloud.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-29T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: procurement readiness & next steps (post demo)

Marissa — quick update from our side after internal sync:

- We're planning to proceed with a direct PO (not Marketplace) to keep timeline tight.
- Confirmed internal milestones: Legal kickoff Mar 30, Security questionnaire delivered Apr 6, Finance sign-off Apr 13, PO expected Apr 15.
- Finance requests an invoice template and our standard PO language to be pre-populated in the SOW (I attached a sample PO language to procurement).

Please send the finalized MSA + SOW (with pre-populated PO language) and the DocuSign envelope when ready. If you can target the contract package to reach Acme legal by end of day Mar 30, that would keep us on track.

Jordan
